description: Defines the EmailsDetailView class extending DetailView2, handling email detail view display logic in SuiteCRM, including setup, populateBean, populateFields, and display methods.

classes.name: EmailsDetailView
classes.description: A class for managing the email detail view in SuiteCRM, extending DetailView2, with methods for setup, populating data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the detail view with module, focus, metadata, template, and focus creation options.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Populates the bean with request data and calls populateFields to handle specific field logic.

methods.name: populateFields
methods.description: Handles special fields like 'from_addr_name', decoding HTML entities and defaulting to 'from_addr' if empty.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the detail view as HTML, optionally showing the title and handling Ajax save requests.
